title: Toddler Left Outside, Mom Located at a Motel With Zero Remorse
description:
On August 6th, 2022. Police responded to a situation regarding a deadbeat mom who left her toddler outside while she hangouts in a motel. When police try to confront her, she tries to blame it on her nonexistent husband. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
